name: Kam-Bur
overview:
The Kambur series follows a resourceful girl seeking recognition who turns electronic waste into robots and gadgets to help children from other planets with their everyday problems. With the help of her sidekick Lizz, a clever and tenacious lizard, Kambur hopes to reach the top spot on an online app.

The two spend their afternoons in the heart of a massive electronic waste dump on Earth in the future. There, they have a laboratory where creativity knows no bounds.
